tip: When something other than the subject opens the sentence, the verb comes before the subject: zat een bekende acteur.
Put in after the noun for motion into: het water in means into the water, while in het water means already inside it.
The verb slagen pairs with voor, not a direct object: slaagde niet voor het examen means did not pass the exam.
werden plus a past participle forms the passive, leaving the doer unnamed: werden de vluchtelingen ontvangen means were received.
